scope: Independent review and focused native WSL RTL regression for the MCP23009 timing/source-list packet, followed by exact-path documentation/state commit review.

review.production_change: sys/mcp23009.sv changes only the MCP23009 i2c parameter from 500000 to 375000; no unrelated RTL edit.
review.qip_registration: files.qip contains exactly the required rtl/diablo_video_source_policy.sv registration for an instantiated tracked module.
review.actual_dut_coverage: mcp23009_rate_tb instantiates the production mcp23009 dut, ACKs its open-drain SDA, observes its SCL waveform, counts starts/completions/errors, and requires corrected timing.
review.negative_controls: The same real i2c divider is exercised at RATE=400000 and RATE=500000 with EXPECT_PASS=0; the test rejects either if low time is at least 1300 ns and period at least 2500 ns.
review.warnings: Only preexisting Verilator warnings were permitted by the runner; no warning was converted into acceptance.

regression.command: C:/Windows/System32/wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "set -euo pipefail; cd /mnt/d/Arcade/AI/aCORES/Diablo; bash support/tests/run_mcp23009_rate_wsl.sh 375000 1; bash support/tests/run_mcp23009_rate_wsl.sh 400000 0; bash support/tests/run_mcp23009_rate_wsl.sh 500000 0"
